market.question: Did Cardi B perform at the Super Bowl LX halftime show?
market.resolutionText:
Official Product Name: "Will <performer> perform at <event>?"

Rulebook: PERFORM

PERFORM

Scope: These rules shall apply to this contract.

Underlying: The Underlying for this Contract is the identity of performers who perform at <event> during the official broadcast or official event timeframe. Revisions to the Underlying made after Expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

Source Agency: The Source Agencies are the official <event>[a] website and social media accounts, <performer>, the official broadcaster of <event>, Billboard, Rolling Stone, Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, Deadline, Entertainment Weekly, Associated Press, Reuters, CNN, NBC, ABC, CBS, Fox, MTV, and official social media accounts of confirmed performers.

Type: The type of Contract is an Event Contract.

Issuance: After the initial Contract, Contract iterations will be listed on an as-needed basis at the discretion of the Exchange and corresponding to the risk management needs of Members.

<event>: <event> refers to a specific entertainment event, awards show, or sporting event specified by the Exchange, including the specific year or date.

<performer>: <performer> refers to a musical artist, band, or person specified by the Exchange[b].

Payout Criterion: The Payout Criterion for the Contract encompasses the Expiration Values that <performer> performs (or it is announced that they will perform at) at <event> during the official event timeframe.

For purposes of this Contract, "performs" means:
- The performer appears on stage or in the official broadcast/stream [c]AND
- Performs (including dancing, singing, DJ-ing, e.g.) AND
- Is either a scheduled performer OR makes a guest appearance during another artist's performance

The following constitutes a performance:
- Solo performances
- Collaborative performances where <performer> is on stage
- Guest appearances where <performer> performs vocals or instruments[d][e]
- Medleys that include <performer>'s music if <performer> is performing
- Pre-recorded performances that are presented as part of the official event

The following does NOT constitute a performance:
- Appearing only as an award presenter or host
- Being in the audience without performing[f]
- Having their music played without their participation
- Appearing in video montages or tribute segments without performing
- Pre-show or post-show performances outside the official event timeframe
- Performances that are cancelled or cut short before reaching 30 seconds
- Sound check or rehearsal footage
- Dancing or appearing on stage without singing/playing instruments

Official event timeframe means:
- For televised events: from the start to end of the official broadcast
- For live events: from the scheduled start time to the official end of the main program
- Does NOT include red carpet, pre-show, or after-party performances unless explicitly specified

If <event> is postponed, the market remains open for the rescheduled event up to one year from the original date. If cancelled entirely, all markets resolve to No. Technical difficulties that prevent broadcast on the air do not invalidate a performance if it otherwise occurred.

Examples that would resolve to Yes:
- <performer> performs a full song as scheduled
- <performer> makes a surprise guest appearance and performs a verse
- <performer> performs as part of a group tribute
- <performer> performs via satellite/video link as part of the official show

Examples that would resolve to No:
- <performer> only presents an award
- <performer> is only shown in the audience
- <performer>'s performance is cancelled due to illness
- <performer> only appears in a pre-taped comedy sketch without performing music

Minimum Tick: The Minimum Tick size for the Contract shall be $0.01.

Position Accountability Level: The Position Accountability Level for the Contract shall be $25,000 per strike, per Member.

Last Trading Date: The Last Trading Date of the Contract will be the same as the Expiration Date. The Last Trading Time will be the same as the Expiration time.

Settlement Date: The Settlement Date of the Contract shall be no later than the day after the Expiration Date, unless the Market Outcome is under review pursuant to Rule 7.1.

Expiration Date: The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be one year and one month after <event> was originally scheduled to take place. If an event described in the Payout Criterion occurs, expiration will be moved to an earlier date and time in accordance with Rule 7.2.

Expiration time: The Expiration time of the Contract shall be 10:00 AM ET.

Settlement Value: The Settlement Value for this Contract is $1.00.

Expiration Value: The Expiration Value is the value of the Underlying as documented by the Source Agency on the Expiration Date at the Expiration time.

Contingencies: Before Settlement, Kalshi may, at its sole discretion, initiate the Market Outcome Review Process pursuant to Rule 6.3(d) of the Rulebook. If an Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date, Kalshi has the right to determine payouts pursuant to Rule 6.3(b) in the Rulebook.

label.marketTitle: Did Cardi B perform at the Super Bowl LX halftime show?
label.whatHappened: Cardi B appeared during Bad Bunny's halftime set, dancing and mouthing lyrics on a pink-porch set but apparently not singing into a mic. Kalshi deemed it ambiguous whether this met the 'performance' definition (per Kalshi: singing+dancing counts, background dancing alone does not), invoked Rule 6.3(c), and settled at the last traded price before pausing — paying YES holders ~$0.26 and NO holders ~$0.74 rather than a binary $1/$0. Polymarket resolved the same event YES at $1.00, a stark cross-platform divergence. Kalshi saw ~$47.3M volume vs Polymarket ~$10M. At least one YES holder filed a CFTC complaint alleging a Commodity Exchange Act violation, saying they received ~$1,300 instead of ~$5,000 and seeking ~$3,700.
